question: HCP Vault Secrets free tier retention is 5 versions per secret (a version count) and its binding per-object cap is 5120 characters (not bytes). The limits vocabulary has retention-clamped and per-object-cap but no character-based unit, and free_tier.unit has no 'secrets' term, so 'objects' is used with the true unit named in the record text. Should the schema add a secrets/versions unit or a character-based per-object cap term?
why: The closed vocabularies lack a term that names a secret count and a character-sized secret value exactly; the record uses the nearest terms and names the true units in stated, limits and notes.

new.slice: HCP Vault Secrets free tier retention is 5 versions per secret (a version count)
